hooks.command:
if [[ -n "$SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL" ]]; then echo "$(date +%s)" > ~/.claude/session_start.tmp; PROJECT_DIR="$(basename "$(pwd)")"; MESSAGE='{"blocks":[{"type":"header","text":{"type":"plain_text","text":"🚀 Claude Code Session Started"}},{"type":"section","fields":[{"type":"mrkdwn","text":"*📁 Project:*
'"$PROJECT_DIR"'"},{"type":"mrkdwn","text":"*⏰ Time:*
'"$(date '+%H:%M:%S')"'"},{"type":"mrkdwn","text":"*📅 Date:*
'"$(date '+%Y-%m-%d')"'"}]}]}'; curl -s -X POST "$SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL" -H "Content-type: application/json" -d "$MESSAGE" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi

if [[ -n "$SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL" ]]; then END_TIME="$(date +%s)"; if [[ -f ~/.claude/session_start.tmp ]]; then START_TIME="$(cat ~/.claude/session_start.tmp)"; DURATION="$((END_TIME - START_TIME))"; MINUTES="$((DURATION / 60))"; SECONDS="$((DURATION % 60))"; DURATION_TEXT="${MINUTES}m ${SECONDS}s"; rm -f ~/.claude/session_start.tmp; else DURATION_TEXT="Unknown"; fi; PROJECT_DIR="$(basename "$(pwd)")"; MEMORY_MB="$(ps -o rss= -p $$ 2>/dev/null | awk '{print int($1/1024)}' || echo 'N/A')"; MESSAGE='{"blocks":[{"type":"header","text":{"type":"plain_text","text":"✅ Claude Code Session Completed"}},{"type":"section","fields":[{"type":"mrkdwn","text":"*📁 Project:*
'"$PROJECT_DIR"'"},{"type":"mrkdwn","text":"*⏱️ Duration:*
'"$DURATION_TEXT"'"},{"type":"mrkdwn","text":"*💾 Memory Used:*
'"${MEMORY_MB}"'MB"},{"type":"mrkdwn","text":"*⏰ Finished:*
'"$(date '+%H:%M:%S')"'"},{"type":"mrkdwn","text":"*📅 Date:*
'"$(date '+%Y-%m-%d')"'"}]}]}'; curl -s -X POST "$SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL" -H "Content-type: application/json" -d "$MESSAGE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "Failed to send detailed Slack notification"; else echo "⚠️ Detailed Slack notification skipped: Set SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL"; fi
